UPSIDA Board Approves Doubled Budget for Industrial Development

The 51st Board Meeting of the Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Authority (UPSIDA) concluded with the approval of a doubled budget for the fiscal year 2026-27. The increased allocation aims to accelerate industrial development within Uttar Pradesh. The decision was made during the board's 51st meeting.
